status: repaired 2026-09-04: 1046 new lines, compile exit 0 with no new warnings. Four steps. (1) POWER-ASSOCIATIVITY, eja_pow_mul_pow: one induction on i+j proving both x^i x^j = x^(i+j) and that the multiplications by x^i and x^j commute; the commuting half comes from Mathlib's two_nsmul_lie_lmul_lmul_add_add_eq_zero, the full linearisation of the Jordan identity, re-exported pointwise as eja_lin, through the relation c_p + c_q + c_r = 0 for p+q+r = N, which with the antisymmetry c_k = -c_(N-k) forces c_k = k c_1 and then N c_1 = 0. (2) Evaluation of real polynomials at x is then a MULTIPLICATIVE linear map ejaEv, so the polynomials killing x are generated by a monic minimal polynomial (eja_exists_minpoly, by division with remainder and minimal degree). (3) FORMAL REALITY FORCES THAT POLYNOMIAL TO SPLIT INTO DISTINCT LINEAR FACTORS: a monic quadratic factor with negative discriminant is a square plus a positive constant, and multiplying the minimal polynomial by the complementary factor writes 0 as a sum of two squares (eja_minpoly_split, on Mathlib's IsMonicOfDegree.eq_isMonicOfDegree_one_or_two_mul); a repeated factor makes a polynomial of smaller degree square to zero (eja_minpoly_nodup). (4) The Lagrange basis polynomials of the roots, evaluated at x, are the spectral idempotents. The POSITIVITY half needs a Euclidean structure, which the formally real definition of the class does not carry, so the file builds the trace form B x y = tr (L (x*y)) itself: it is associative because the commutator of two multiplications is a derivation (eja_der - exactly two instances of the linearised identity added, the four four-fold products cancelling by commutativity), and positive definite (ejaB_self_pos) by the spectral theorem together with the positivity of the trace of a non-zero idempotent (eja_tr_idem_pos, from the Peirce relation 2L^3 - 3L^2 + L = 0 at an idempotent and the two idempotent Peirce projections, whose traces are the ranks of their ranges). Then L p is positive semidefinite for B whenever p is idempotent, so a sum of squares pairs non-negatively with every idempotent, and that is what forces the spectral values of a sum of squares to be non-negative.

The Vhalf component of U_g q needs the Vhalf component z = 2 c z + 2 d z of g g = g, which is easy to overlook. The Peirce products this needs are four lines each, except Phalf (z z) = 0, which is one instance eja_lin q z z q of the linearised Jordan identity in which four of the six terms cancel in pairs. (2) FROM PRIMITIVE TO THE WHOLE CONE, about 130 lines. A non-zero idempotent that is not primitive splits: its Peirce 1-space contains an element off R e, and the spectral decomposition of that element INSIDE the corner EJACorner e has at least two terms, either of which is an idempotent p with 0 =/= p =/= e below e (eja_idem_split). V1(p) and V1(e - p) are then strictly inside V1(e), so a recursion on the dimension of V1 (ejaV1 = ker (L_p - id), eja_V1_lt) shows that a linear map positive on primitive idempotents is positive on every idempotent, and the spectral theorem extends that to the cone (eja_nonneg_of_primitive). For an idempotent c with c a = 0, U_(l c + a) = U_(l c + (1 - c)) after U_(c + a); both sides are linear, so it is enough to check the three Peirce spaces of c - on V1 both are l^2, on V0 both are U_a, and on Vhalf both are 2 l L_a, because U_a VANISHES on Vhalf(c). That last fact is one line: the instance eja_lin a a y c of the linearised identity, in which three terms vanish (a c = 0 and a a c = 0) and two coincide, reads 2 a (a y) = a a y.
